title: SPATAIL library asset metadata

fields.name: human-readable name
fields.path: URL of the GLB within the public/ web root (may not exist yet)
fields.scaleMeters: [x,y,z] display size in metres (runtime rescales to room)
fields.placementTypes: where it can anchor: table | floor | floating
fields.supportsAnimation: can be animated by a behaviour
fields.fallbackPrimitive: runtime proxy shape when no GLB exists: arrow, capsule, cone, cube, cylinder, half_sphere, line, none, plane, ring, rounded_cube, sphere, torus
fields.primitiveSpec: (optional) extra dims/axis for the fallback primitive

resolutionOrder: 3 runtime primitive enriched by the matched catalog entry
5 generate in Blender -> cache back into the library
